reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and threads it to every caller, but writes the 'weekend or holiday' test inline at each skip filter instead of one shared predicate.

duplication.why: The 'isWeekend || holidays.includes(dayFromDate(...))' check is written four times (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) and the holiday-sized lookahead arithmetic three different ways.

placement.why: The moving rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip holiday rule is spread across server/schedules/app.ts and shared/schedules.ts copies.

scope.why: Only the holiday threading, the type field and tests change.

maintainability.why: Each copy of the skip filter had to be edited by hand and the reverse fallback in getNextDate was missed (it still filters only weekends), showing how the scattered rule drifts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend moves go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the skip filters were already per-site copies before the change and no shared skip helper existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated holiday check is copied verbatim in visible form at each site, not disguised.

one_place.where: Holiday moving is in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but holiday skipping for daily schedules is added separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (and missed in getNextDate's reverse fallback).
